headline: Ramani Iyer Files SEBI Takeover Disclosure for Substantial Acquisition in Just Dial Limited
sum: Individual acquirer Ramani Iyer has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial share acquisition (5%+ threshold) in Just Dial Limited, a listed digital services platform. The filing triggers mandatory open offer or exemption conditions under SEBI takeover rules.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures lock in a 60-day open offer timeline if the acquirer intends to go above 26% or seek exemption; practitioners must immediately review the acquisition method (direct purchase, creeping, or conditional) and exemption eligibility under Regulation 10(1) or 10(3) to structure the avoidance or satisfaction of the open offer.
detail: The disclosure was filed by Ramani Iyer with the NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), which requires mandatory disclosure when a person acquires 5% or more of shares or voting rights in a listed company. Just Dial Limited is a major Indian online directory and local search platform listed on NSE. The exact stake percentage and consideration remain undisclosed in the Bar & Bench report, but the regulatory filing signals the commencement of formal acquisition formalities. The disclosure triggers a 60-day open offer regime unless an exemption under Regulations 10 or 11 is available (e.g., acquisition from promoter, preferential allotment, or regulatory relief).

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4
framework.note: Defines 'acquisition' and triggers (25%, 35%, 50%, 75% thresholds); sets disclosure and open offer obligations.
Mandates disclosure to stock exchange within 2 working days of acquisition of 5% or more shares/voting rights.
Specifies open offer requirement (minimum 26% or higher thresholds) and key exemptions (promoter acquisition, preferential allotment, regulatory relief).
Governs content, timing and dispatch of open offer letter; sets minimum offer price benchmarks (higher of 30-day/6-month/52-week VWAP or board-approved price).
Parent statute empowering SEBI to regulate substantial acquisitions and takeovers; defines 'takeover' mechanics.
Sets disclosure by acquirer and target; defines 'in-principle approval' timeline (30 days for open offer from filing of PA application).
Procedural rules for SEBI takeover filings, disclosure formats, and exchange-level coordination; filing via RTA or acquirer's DSC.

conditions: Acquisition of 5% or higher shareholding in Just Dial Limited
Mandatory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) within 2 working days
Open offer regime triggered unless exemption under Regulation 10(1)/10(3) applies
approvals: Open offer approval from SEBI (if applicable) within 30 days
Regulatory relief or exemption determination (if sought)
structure.novel: Individual acquirer (Ramani Iyer) filing; no stated exemption or special structure disclosed in the filing notice itself.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)

Minimum offer price determination and letter of offer dispatch rules if open offer is required.
